question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘MOBILE’ from the given sentence.**

The strange TV reporter standing over there covers all the funny and interesting things happening inside the town.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Standing**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mobile**: Able to move or be moved freely or easily. (स्थानांतरित करने या स्वतंत्र रूप से या आसानी से स्थानांतरित करने में सक्षम)
 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given options.
 
 
• **Standing**: The act of a person or thing that stands; not moveable and therefore fixed. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु का खड़ा होना; चलने योग्य नहीं है और इसलिए स्थिर है)
 
• **Interesting**: Arousing curiosity or interest; holding or catching the attention. (दिलचस्प)
 
• **Inside**: The inner side or surface of something. (अंदर)
 
• **Strange**: Unusual or surprising; difficult to understand or explain. (अजीब)
 
 
 
• From the meaning of the given words, it is clear that the most appropriate antonym of the word ‘**Mobile**’ is '**Standing**'.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.
